saṅkoca.p: [ saṃ + kuca + ṇa. ] (ti) CL=8 Nīti, dhātu. 30 - 1. Saṃkoca - saṃ. Saṃkoa - prā ]   (1)who is lazy and demoralized; he . (Pu) (2)  shrinkage and contraction. (3) Laziness. (1) See the article below.

saṅkocana.p: [ saṃ + kuca + yu. ] (na) CL=8 Nīti, dhātu. 30 - 1. Saṃkocana - saṃ. Saṃkoaṇa - prā. Saṃkoyaṇa - addhamādhī ]  (1) shortness of breath (2) Bending-folding and twisting. (1) Saṅkocana - paccuppaṭṭhāna  - See.
